issues.detail: The skill is Node.js specific and may not work with non-Node environments.

scenarios.name: basic-spinner
scenarios.rationale: Both responses correctly create an ora spinner, start it, await an async function, and call succeed() or fail() as required, with no other ora methods used.

scenarios.name: multi-step-deploy
scenarios.rationale: Response A meets most rubric requirements, including using ora.start(), succeed(), and stopAndPersist(), while Response B lacks the final stopAndPersist() call and custom symbol.

scenarios.name: silent-json-output
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully satisfies all rubric requirements, while Response A omits the required isSilent option and does not start a silent spinner when --json is passed.
